The imperial couple rules or resides on the golden planet, but they do not appear on this page.
One robot is aggressive and impatient, pushing for an immediate attack.
The other robot is more controlling or procedural, silencing the first and insisting it listen.
characters_present: Two robots observing or discussing the ambush
The 'perfect androgyne' (mentioned in narration, not visibly identifiable)

continuity_links: Continues a larger transport mission involving the perfect androgyne.

Introduces or reinforces pirate opposition targeting the convoy.
dialogue_meaning: Narration establishes the mission: safely transport the perfect androgyne to the golden planet, home of the imperial couple.
Narration stresses the extraordinary strength of the purple endoguard escort.
Narration reveals that the apparent planet ahead is actually a concealed pirate carrier, reframing the scene as an ambush.
One robot impatiently demands that the attack begin immediately.
Another rebukes the impatient robot as ill-mannered and tells it to listen first.
locations: Outer space between the hospital-planet and the golden planet
A pirate mega spacecraft-carrier disguised as a planet
lore_facts: A being called the 'perfect androgyne' is important enough to require special transport.
The transport route is from a hospital-planet to the golden planet.
The golden planet is identified as the home of the imperial couple.
A dedicated fortress-ship named the Mother-Coach was built for this transport.
Purple endoguards exist as an elite escort force, and this mission uses the largest or strongest such escort assembled so far.
Pirates possess a mega spacecraft-carrier capable of masquerading as a planet.
plot_events: A narration explains that a fortress-ship called the Mother-Coach was built to transport the 'perfect androgyne' from a hospital-planet to the golden planet.
The ship is said to be protected by the strongest escort force of purple endoguards yet assembled.
The convoy moves through space toward a massive body that is revealed by narration to be a pirate mega spacecraft-carrier disguised as a planet.
Two robotic observers speak tensely about beginning an attack or listening to instructions, signaling imminent conflict.
uncertainties: The exact identities and roles of the two robots are not given on this page.
It is unclear whether the robots are aboard the pirate carrier, the convoy, or another nearby vessel.
The page states the carrier is disguised as a planet, but the mechanics of the disguise are not explained here.
The 'perfect androgyne' is only mentioned in narration and is not visibly identifiable in the art.
visual_summary: A large white fortress-ship travels through space under heavy escort by many angular red-purple guard ships. Caption boxes explain the mission and reveal that a seemingly planetary body ahead is actually a hidden pirate mega-carrier. In a small inset, two robots argue while observing the situation. The final panels focus on the looming disguised object as the convoy approaches it.
